scope: Bounded local host author measurements. Original AP provider unchanged; all logical messages distinct/exact-once and all workers joined. Queue payload is an eight-byte index/check pair into equal caller-owned immutable bodies. Capacity31 is an upper bound, with AP conservative pool admission distinguished. No host settings, privileged counters, physical cache claim or sanitizer timing inference.
